pages.title: Wrought in Iron
pages.text: A Warding Emblem grants armor, and its protection strengthens as the dragon reaches new growth stages.

pages.title: Crafting the Emblem
pages.text: A central name tag, surrounded above, below, left, and right by four iron blocks; leave corners empty.

pages.title: Protection in Both Forms
pages.text: The emblem works in both forms. If you worry about accidentally hitting your companion in a fight, take a look at the $(l:dragonmaid:accessories/guardian_tag)Guardian Tag$(/l) too.
